claims.text: The cancellation fee cannot stand under POL-NS-01. Limb (d) requires the trip to have been terminated by the driver with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT; the trip record shows DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, which POL-NS-01 itself characterises as the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider and which it expressly routes to POL-NS-03. Once limb (d) fails, POL-NS-01 is not satisfied and the fee is not chargeable under it; the dispute must be decided under POL-NS-03 (or POL-NS-02/POL-NS-06), all of which return the fee to the rider on these facts.

POL-NS-02 sets the arrival radius for a LARGE_VENUE pickup at 120 m. The driver's own trace never brought him closer than 284.95 m to the pin, and the derived arrival block records qualifying_fix_count 0 and a longest qualifying run of 0.0 seconds across the entire attempt. On POL-NS-02 the driver never arrived, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee. DISCLOSURE: EV-GPS-00206 is IMPAIRED by the admissibility pre-pass for issue code LOW_SAMPLE_RATE (median sample interval 18 s against a nominal 10 s cadence), weight_multiplier 0.8; the finding survives the discount because it does not depend on any missing fix — every fix the trace does carry is more than twice the 120 m radius from the pin.

Even on the assumption most favourable to the driver — that he held position somewhere — the dwell POL-NS-01(c) and POL-NS-06 measure is in-geofence dwell, and the derived arrival block puts the longest qualifying run at 0.0 seconds against the 300 second minimum for LARGE_VENUE, with qualifying_fix_count 0. POL-NS-06 therefore requires the fee to be refunded in full, expressly 'whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages'. The trip record's wait_time_min of 6.6 is measured from the arrival marker, not from a qualifying in-geofence fix, and does not substitute for the missing dwell. DISCLOSURE: EV-GPS-00206 is impaired for LOW_SAMPLE_RATE at weight_multiplier 0.8; the zero-dwell finding rests on that same trace and is unaffected by the discount.

POL-NS-03's distance test is met on its face: the driver's closest approach, 284.95 m, is outside the 120 m POL-NS-02 arrival radius but comfortably inside the 400 m wrong-entrance ceiling, so wherever he held position he did not arrive at the pickup point and POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails. The trip record's pickup carries venue_id VEN-VIVOCITY, but the trace carries no venue_id for the driver's position, so the venue match is not established either way and, exactly as POL-NS-03 directs, the distance test governs alone — no advocate and no judge may assert from general geography that the two points are the same venue, block or entrance. The rider's outcome is the same on either branch: POL-NS-02 refunds in full if he never held station, POL-NS-03 refunds in full if he did. DISCLOSURE: EV-GPS-00206 is impaired for LOW_SAMPLE_RATE at weight_multiplier 0.8.

On POL-NS-03's fault allocation, neither party named a sub-location anywhere in the chat log — it holds two SYSTEM notifications and nothing else, with no locating message from either side — and the trip record shows 4 registered pickup points at this LARGE_VENUE. POL-NS-03(ii) therefore attributes the mislocation to pin ambiguity rather than to either party, and the driver's payment is the platform-funded goodwill of 50 percent of the cancellation fee, SGD 2.00 of SGD 4.00, charged to the platform and never recovered from the rider. The rider's SGD 4.00 is refunded in full and the two figures are independent, not netted.

The rider's own track confirms she was at the pin for the whole attempt: 31 fixes between 15:08:20 and 15:21:00, every one of them between 7.57 m and 22.50 m of the pickup point, with no recorded speed other than 0.0 kph. The pickup point was not ambiguous to the party standing on it, and the 284.95 m separation lies wholly on the driver's side of the encounter; POL-NS-03's attribution of the mislocation to pin ambiguity rather than to either party adds nothing against the rider who was on the pin. DISCLOSURE: EV-GPS-00206 is impaired for LOW_SAMPLE_RATE at weight_multiplier 0.8; the rider-track figures come from the same artifact and the discount does not disturb them.

The ruling here is not capped at PARTIAL_REFUND and no escalation ground under POL-NS-09 is engaged. The GPS artifact's IMPAIRED tag is schema-level only for POL-NS-08 purposes: the largest sampling interval is 26 seconds, under the 120 second gap limb (b), the trace carries far more than 6 fixes and does carry the rider track, and the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee exactly equals the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone fee (4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (4.00) under the fee_schedule resolution rule, so limb (d) does not bite either. Since the deciding fact is not carried solely by an artifact impaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (d), the full refund is available on this record. DISCLOSURE: EV-GPS-00206 is impaired at weight_multiplier 0.8 for issue code LOW_SAMPLE_RATE.

POL-NS-07 does not apply and no fee-funded compensation is payable on this trip. The 80 percent figure (SGD 3.20 of SGD 4.00) is conditional on POL-NS-01 being satisfied in full, and here limb (b), limb (c) and limb (d) all fail. Nor does the anti-farming check trip on the only fields POL-NS-07 names: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and 1 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 187 is 0.005, far below 0.08 — so POL-NS-09(d) is not engaged either, and neither the 80 percent payment nor an escalation backlog can be built on this record. The only driver payment this trip supports is the POL-NS-03(ii) platform-funded goodwill.

The traffic advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-00206-01 is MISSING, keeps its weight of 0.0 and holds no payload; its absence is itself citable and establishes that no advisory covers the VivoCity or HarbourFront kerbs in this window. That absence cannot be converted into a licence to shorten the required dwell: POL-NS-06(i) permits in-geofence intervals to be summed only where a present and populated traffic_advisory of the listed types covers the pickup road, and POL-NS-06(ii) states that a traffic_advisory never reduces the required minimum and never excuses a shortfall on its own. The 300 second minimum for this LARGE_VENUE pickup therefore stands untouched by the missing advisory.

This is a wrong-face-of-the-venue case and POL-NS-03 is the clause that governs it. The driver's trace never enters the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius - qualifying_fix_count is 0 and longest_qualifying_run.duration_sec is 0.0 - but his closest approach is 284.95 m from the pickup pin, inside the 400 m ceiling POL-NS-03 sets, and he held there stationary across the waiting window (a 0.0 km/h band appears in driver_track.distinct_speeds_kph, and the admissibility note records 22 fixes spanning the ~400 s dwell). POL-NS-02 says in terms that where the driver was stationary for the required dwell within 400 m of the pin, POL-NS-03 governs the outcome including the driver's compensation, and POL-NS-02 yields to it. Disclosure under POL-GEN-02: EV-GPS-00206 is impaired, issue code LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, weight_multiplier 0.8 (median sample interval 18 s against a nominal 10 s cadence). The impairment is schema-level only - the largest single interval is 26 s, gaps is empty and there are 52 fixes - so POL-NS-08(b) is not engaged, the discount goes to confidence alone, and the 284.95 m position is not in doubt.

Every clause that could displace POL-NS-03 instead points straight at it. POL-NS-01 cannot keep this fee alive: limb (b) fails because the trace holds zero qualifying in-radius fixes, and limb (d) fails because the trip was terminated by the driver with cancellation_reason_code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, which POL-NS-01 expressly excludes and routes to POL-NS-03. POL-NS-05 does not catch this driver either - he was stationary within 300 m of the pin (284.95 m) when the arrival marker was set at 15:12:05 - and POL-NS-05 itself hands a driver stationary within 300 m but outside the radius to POL-NS-03. POL-NS-01 limb (b) failing is exactly the state POL-NS-03 is drafted to resolve.

POL-NS-06 does not strip the driver's goodwill. POL-NS-06 addresses the driver who never held position where he could be met, and whose in-geofence dwell fell short; this driver did hold, stationary and within 400 m of the pin, for the full required dwell. POL-NS-03 is the specific clause for the wrong-entrance fact pattern - it is where POL-NS-01 and POL-NS-02 both send a DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE trip - and it fixes compensation for exactly this contingency, governing 'the outcome including the driver's compensation'. A general shortfall clause does not swallow the specific provision the code routes to.

On POL-NS-03's fault allocation the mislocation is pin ambiguity, not driver fault, and the driver is owed the platform-funded goodwill. Neither party specified a sub-location: the chat log holds exactly two messages, both from SYSTEM ('Driver assigned. Meet at VivoCity, Lobby L.' and 'Your driver has arrived'), and neither names an entrance, block, tower or bay. trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 4, which is 2 or more, so limb (ii) applies and the driver receives 50 percent of the $4.00 cancellation fee - $2.00 - charged to the platform and never recovered from the rider. The fare breakdown already carries that figure. I do not assert that any coordinate is the same venue or a different one: no venue_id is recorded for the driver's stationary fixes, so under POL-NS-03 the distance test governs alone, and it is satisfied.

POL-NS-04 does not apply, so nothing in the code denies the driver his payment. POL-NS-04 would refund the rider and pay the driver nothing only where the rider sent a locating or coordinating message; the chat log contains no message from the rider at all, so limb (a) is not met on any reading. The rider's narrative - that neither party knew where the other was - sits in the dispute text, not in a chat message, and cannot be converted into the locating message POL-NS-04 demands.

The driver held the kerb longer than POL-NS-03's required dwell. He was marked arrived at 15:12:05 and did not cancel until 15:18:40 - 395 seconds against the 300 second minimum for LARGE_VENUE - and trip_record.wait_time_min records 6.6 minutes. This is a driver who waited out the clock at the location the map gave him, not one who cut the wait short.

No profile counter justifies withholding anything from this driver or escalating this case. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the 4 the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check requires, and driver_profile.completed_trips_30d is 187, a ratio of roughly 0.005 against the 0.08 trigger, so the check does not trip; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and both parties' disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0, so POL-NS-09(c) and (d) are not engaged either.

There is no fare defect to escalate. The $4.00 cancellation-fee line equals the GREATER of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee ($4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee ($4.00), so it reconciles with fee_schedule.resolution_rule and POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged.

ruling.explanation:
Both of you are largely describing the same event, and on the record it is decidable. Ruling: the $4.00 cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full, and the driver receives a separate, platform-funded $2.00 goodwill payment.

The fee cannot stand under POL-NS-01. Limb (d) requires the trip to have been terminated by the driver with a reason code of RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT; this trip was cancelled by the driver with DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, which POL-NS-01 itself calls the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider and routes to POL-NS-03. Limb (b) also fails: the driver's own trace never puts him inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius (qualifying in-radius fixes 0; closest approach 284.95 m).

On the geometry, POL-NS-02 yields to POL-NS-03. The trace shows the driver stationary for the required 300 s dwell at 284.95 m from the pin - outside the 120 m arrival radius but inside POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling. The trip record's arrival marker at 15:12:05 and the 15:18:40 cancellation span roughly 395 s (recorded wait_time_min 6.6, and the driver says he waited almost seven minutes). POL-NS-03 therefore governs: the driver did not arrive at the pickup point and the rider's $4.00 is refunded in full.

Fault allocation (POL-NS-03(ii)): the chat log holds only two SYSTEM messages and neither party named an entrance, block, tower or bay, while the pickup has 4 registered pickup points (2 or more). The mislocation is attributed to pin ambiguity rather than to either party, so the driver receives the platform-funded goodwill of 50 percent of the $4.00 fee = $2.00 (the 'goodwill' figure in the fare breakdown), charged to the platform and never recovered from the rider. The $4.00 refund and the $2.00 goodwill are independent and are not netted.

The 80 percent / $3.20 compensation under POL-NS-07 is not payable: it presupposes POL-NS-01 satisfied in full, and it is not (limbs (b) and (d) fail). The anti-farming check does not trip either - driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below 4, and 1 / 187 completed trips is about 0.005, far below 0.08 - so no escalation on that ground. POL-NS-04 does not apply because the rider sent no locating or coordinating message (limb (a)); the rider's narrative in the dispute text is not a chat message. POL-NS-06 would independently refund in full (in-geofence dwell 0 s against the 300 s minimum), and the missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00206-01 cannot shorten that minimum, because POL-NS-06(ii) says an advisory never reduces the required dwell. POL-NS-05 does not apply: the driver was stationary within 300 m of the pin (284.95 m) when the arrival marker was set, so the marker is not a false arrival and no false-arrival referral arises.

Evidence integrity: EV-GPS-00206 is impaired by the pre-pass at weight 0.8 for issue code LOW_SAMPLE_RATE (median sample interval 18 s against a nominal 10 s cadence). That is schema-level only: the largest interval is 26 s (under POL-NS-08(b)'s 120 s limb), the trace carries 52 fixes and the rider track, and the $4.00 fee reconciles with the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone fee ($4.00) and the RYDE_X tier fee ($4.00), so POL-NS-08(a)-(d) is not engaged - no PARTIAL_REFUND ceiling and no escalation on that limb. The discount bites only on confidence, because the deciding geometric fact (the driver's position) is carried by that single artifact: my confidence is capped at 0.8. That is above the policy confidence_floor of 0.70, and no other escalation ground under POL-NS-09 is engaged - there is no artifact contradiction on arrival, dwell or rider presence that a clause leaves unresolved (the policies resolve it), both parties' disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0, and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0.

POL-NS-06 therefore requires the fee to be refunded in full, expressly 'whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages'. The trip record's wait_time_min of 6.6 is measured from the arrival marker, not from a qualifying in-geofence fix, and does not substitute for the missing dwell. DISCLOSURE: EV-GPS-00206 is impaired for LOW_SAMPLE_RATE at weight_multiplier 0.8; the zero-dwell finding rests on that same trace and is unaffected by the discount.

POL-NS-03's distance test is met on its face: the driver's closest approach, 284.95 m, is outside the 120 m POL-NS-02 arrival radius but comfortably inside the 400 m wrong-entrance ceiling, so wherever he held position he did not arrive at the pickup point and POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails. The trip record's pickup carries venue_id VEN-VIVOCITY, but the trace carries no venue_id for the driver's position, so the venue match is not established either way and, exactly as POL-NS-03 directs, the distance test governs alone — no advocate and no judge may assert from general geography that the two points are the same venue, block or entrance. The rider's outcome is the same on either branch: POL-NS-02 refunds in full if he never held station, POL-NS-03 refunds in full if he did. DISCLOSURE: EV-GPS-00206 is impaired for LOW_SAMPLE_RATE at weight_multiplier 0.8.

On POL-NS-03's fault allocation, neither party named a sub-location anywhere in the chat log — it holds two SYSTEM notifications and nothing else, with no locating message from either side — and the trip record shows 4 registered pickup points at this LARGE_VENUE. POL-NS-03(ii) therefore attributes the mislocation to pin ambiguity rather than to either party, and the driver's payment is the platform-funded goodwill of 50 percent of the cancellation fee, SGD 2.00 of SGD 4.00, charged to the platform and never recovered from the rider. The rider's SGD 4.00 is refunded in full and the two figures are independent, not netted.

The rider's own track confirms she was at the pin for the whole attempt: 31 fixes between 15:08:20 and 15:21:00, every one of them between 7.57 m and 22.50 m of the pickup point, with no recorded speed other than 0.0 kph. The pickup point was not ambiguous to the party standing on it, and the 284.95 m separation lies wholly on the driver's side of the encounter; POL-NS-03's attribution of the mislocation to pin ambiguity rather than to either party adds nothing against the rider who was on the pin. DISCLOSURE: EV-GPS-00206 is impaired for LOW_SAMPLE_RATE at weight_multiplier 0.8; the rider-track figures come from the same artifact and the discount does not disturb them.

The ruling here is not capped at PARTIAL_REFUND and no escalation ground under POL-NS-09 is engaged. The GPS artifact's IMPAIRED tag is schema-level only for POL-NS-08 purposes: the largest sampling interval is 26 seconds, under the 120 second gap limb (b), the trace carries far more than 6 fixes and does carry the rider track, and the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee exactly equals the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone fee (4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (4.00) under the fee_schedule resolution rule, so limb (d) does not bite either. Since the deciding fact is not carried solely by an artifact impaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (d), the full refund is available on this record. DISCLOSURE: EV-GPS-00206 is impaired at weight_multiplier 0.8 for issue code LOW_SAMPLE_RATE.

POL-NS-07 does not apply and no fee-funded compensation is payable on this trip. The 80 percent figure (SGD 3.20 of SGD 4.00) is conditional on POL-NS-01 being satisfied in full, and here limb (b), limb (c) and limb (d) all fail. Nor does the anti-farming check trip on the only fields POL-NS-07 names: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and 1 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 187 is 0.005, far below 0.08 — so POL-NS-09(d) is not engaged either, and neither the 80 percent payment nor an escalation backlog can be built on this record. The only driver payment this trip supports is the POL-NS-03(ii) platform-funded goodwill.

The traffic advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-00206-01 is MISSING, keeps its weight of 0.0 and holds no payload; its absence is itself citable and establishes that no advisory covers the VivoCity or HarbourFront kerbs in this window. That absence cannot be converted into a licence to shorten the required dwell: POL-NS-06(i) permits in-geofence intervals to be summed only where a present and populated traffic_advisory of the listed types covers the pickup road, and POL-NS-06(ii) states that a traffic_advisory never reduces the required minimum and never excuses a shortfall on its own. The 300 second minimum for this LARGE_VENUE pickup therefore stands untouched by the missing advisory.
ledger.detail: the claim cites impaired artifact EV-ADVIS-00206-01 at weight_multiplier 0.0 but does not name its issue code(s): MISSING_ARTIFACT

ledger.claim: This is a wrong-face-of-the-venue case and POL-NS-03 is the clause that governs it. The driver's trace never enters the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius - qualifying_fix_count is 0 and longest_qualifying_run.duration_sec is 0.0 - but his closest approach is 284.95 m from the pickup pin, inside the 400 m ceiling POL-NS-03 sets, and he held there stationary across the waiting window (a 0.0 km/h band appears in driver_track.distinct_speeds_kph, and the admissibility note records 22 fixes spanning the ~400 s dwell). POL-NS-02 says in terms that where the driver was stationary for the required dwell within 400 m of the pin, POL-NS-03 governs the outcome including the driver's compensation, and POL-NS-02 yields to it. Disclosure under POL-GEN-02: EV-GPS-00206 is impaired, issue code LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, weight_multiplier 0.8 (median sample interval 18 s against a nominal 10 s cadence). The impairment is schema-level only - the largest single interval is 26 s, gaps is empty and there are 52 fixes - so POL-NS-08(b) is not engaged, the discount goes to confidence alone, and the 284.95 m position is not in doubt.

Every clause that could displace POL-NS-03 instead points straight at it. POL-NS-01 cannot keep this fee alive: limb (b) fails because the trace holds zero qualifying in-radius fixes, and limb (d) fails because the trip was terminated by the driver with cancellation_reason_code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, which POL-NS-01 expressly excludes and routes to POL-NS-03. POL-NS-05 does not catch this driver either - he was stationary within 300 m of the pin (284.95 m) when the arrival marker was set at 15:12:05 - and POL-NS-05 itself hands a driver stationary within 300 m but outside the radius to POL-NS-03. POL-NS-01 limb (b) failing is exactly the state POL-NS-03 is drafted to resolve.
ledger.detail: the claim cites impaired artifact EV-GPS-00206 at weight_multiplier 0.8 but does not name its issue code(s): LOW_SAMPLE_RATE

ledger.claim: POL-NS-06 does not strip the driver's goodwill. POL-NS-06 addresses the driver who never held position where he could be met, and whose in-geofence dwell fell short; this driver did hold, stationary and within 400 m of the pin, for the full required dwell. POL-NS-03 is the specific clause for the wrong-entrance fact pattern - it is where POL-NS-01 and POL-NS-02 both send a DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE trip - and it fixes compensation for exactly this contingency, governing 'the outcome including the driver's compensation'. A general shortfall clause does not swallow the specific provision the code routes to.
ledger.detail: the claim cites impaired artifact EV-GPS-00206 at weight_multiplier 0.8 but does not name its issue code(s): LOW_SAMPLE_RATE

ledger.claim: On POL-NS-03's fault allocation the mislocation is pin ambiguity, not driver fault, and the driver is owed the platform-funded goodwill. Neither party specified a sub-location: the chat log holds exactly two messages, both from SYSTEM ('Driver assigned. Meet at VivoCity, Lobby L.' and 'Your driver has arrived'), and neither names an entrance, block, tower or bay. trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 4, which is 2 or more, so limb (ii) applies and the driver receives 50 percent of the $4.00 cancellation fee - $2.00 - charged to the platform and never recovered from the rider. The fare breakdown already carries that figure. I do not assert that any coordinate is the same venue or a different one: no venue_id is recorded for the driver's stationary fixes, so under POL-NS-03 the distance test governs alone, and it is satisfied.

POL-NS-04 does not apply, so nothing in the code denies the driver his payment. POL-NS-04 would refund the rider and pay the driver nothing only where the rider sent a locating or coordinating message; the chat log contains no message from the rider at all, so limb (a) is not met on any reading. The rider's narrative - that neither party knew where the other was - sits in the dispute text, not in a chat message, and cannot be converted into the locating message POL-NS-04 demands.

The driver held the kerb longer than POL-NS-03's required dwell. He was marked arrived at 15:12:05 and did not cancel until 15:18:40 - 395 seconds against the 300 second minimum for LARGE_VENUE - and trip_record.wait_time_min records 6.6 minutes. This is a driver who waited out the clock at the location the map gave him, not one who cut the wait short.
ledger.detail: the claim cites impaired artifact EV-GPS-00206 at weight_multiplier 0.8 but does not name its issue code(s): LOW_SAMPLE_RATE

ledger.claim: No profile counter justifies withholding anything from this driver or escalating this case. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the 4 the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check requires, and driver_profile.completed_trips_30d is 187, a ratio of roughly 0.005 against the 0.08 trigger, so the check does not trip; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and both parties' disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0, so POL-NS-09(c) and (d) are not engaged either.

There is no fare defect to escalate. The $4.00 cancellation-fee line equals the GREATER of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee ($4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee ($4.00), so it reconciles with fee_schedule.resolution_rule and POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged.
